name: Auth0
summary: Identity and sign-in platform from Okta.

flows.title: Create a tenant role
steps: Go to Dashboard > User Management > Roles and select Create Role.
Name the role and add a description, then select Create. A tenant role applies across the entire tenant and can be assigned to any user.

flows.title: Create an Organization role
steps: Go to Dashboard > Organizations and select the Organization.
Select the Roles tab, then select Create Role.
Enter a name and description for the role, then select Create.

flows.title: Assign a role to a user
steps: Go to Dashboard > User Management > Users.
Click ... next to the user and select Assign Roles.
Choose the role or roles to assign, then click Assign. If the list of roles is blank, create a role first.
